The Herdr (herdr.dev) terminal-multiplexer server — the pinned v0.8.2
release binary installed, with a supervised headless server (herdr
server) and a TCP socket bridge (port 8095, socat TCP accept to the
server's unix socket). Host-side consumers — the `herdr:` check verb
(ResolveEndpoint over the reverse channel) and
`charly herdr --endpoint tcp://127.0.0.1:8095` (CLI) — probe the SAME
NDJSON wire contract the herdr CLI uses. Runs as uid 1000 with the
server socket under $HOME/.config/herdr/herdr.sock. The bed
(check-herdr-pod) exercises every capability live.

## Services

- `herdr-server`
- `herdr-bridge`
